previousRule: My Home checkout regression coverage did not verify that anonymous cushion and motorised-track orders can persist under a guest-owned checkout attempt. Production checkout code required a signed-in customer before those order records could be created.
newRule: Keep saved Cushion Studio designs account-only, while My Home cushion and motorised-track purchases use a shop-scoped random checkout attempt. Test guest persistence, account-only saved-design ownership, and compatibility with signed-in attempts created before this release.
reason: Shopify already permits guest checkout, but the app's order persistence rejected anonymous customers before they reached Shopify. The new test protects the narrower My Home guest path without weakening pricing, purchase, or payment validation.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner approved implementing the guest-checkout alternative. This record describes the protected regression test; the exact-head Nylon1 approval comment required by the protected production policy is still pending.
